as_told.title: Spielberg privately told Rob Liefeld aliens are time travelers

plain: The film director Steven Spielberg is said to have asked Robert Liefeld, the comic-book artist who created the character Deadpool, whether it was easier to believe we are watched by aliens from another world or by ourselves, studying us from the future. Michels tells this several times, citing Liefeld, and places it in 1993; in other versions he gives no year, puts it as future humans guarding us, names Zeta Reticuli and Proxima Centauri as the alien alternatives, or says flatly that Spielberg called the aliens time travellers. If true, one of Hollywood's best-known makers of alien films would privately lean toward the idea that the visitors are us.
